Here's a summary of the **9 issues found and fixed**:

### Root level
| # | Issue | Fix |
|---|-------|-----|
| 1 | **Unconditional import** of `eng\custom-analyzers.props` breaks fresh clones | Added `Condition="Exists(...)"` |
| 2 | **`CustomBeforeMicrosoftCommonTargets` set in `.targets`** — too late, SDK already imported `Microsoft.Common.targets` | Moved to `Directory.Build.props` |
| 3 | **`RunCodeGen` not extensible** — other teams can't inject pre/post steps | Added `DependsOnTargets="$(RunCodeGenDependsOn)"` pattern |

### `hard/` subdirectory
| # | Issue | Fix |
|---|-------|-----|
| 4 | **Circular import condition** — `Common.props` only imported if `CommonPropsImported==true`, but that property is *defined inside* `Common.props` | Changed to `Exists()` condition |
| 5 | **`ImportByWildcard*=false`** blocks NuGet `build/` folder imports, breaking `MyAnalyzer.BuildTasks` | Removed the properties |
| 6 | **`CustomBeforeMicrosoftCommonTargets` in `.targets`** — same timing issue | Moved to `.props` |
| 7 | **Unconditional import** of `$(RepoToolsPath)\code-analysis.targets` | Added `Exists()` guard |
| 8 | **Target name `GenerateAssemblyInfo`** collides with SDK built-in | Renamed to `GenerateCustomAssemblyInfo` |
| 9 | **`AfterTargets="_CopyFilesMarkedCopyLocal"`** uses a private SDK target | Changed to `AfterTargets="Build"` |
